channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Huge NATO exercise kicks off in Central Europe
item.description: NATO has begun its largest military exercise of 2026, Steadfast Dart, with allied forces deploying across Central Europe as part of a major test of Alliance rapid reaction capability, according to NATO. The post Huge NATO exercise kicks off in Central Europe first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK weighs support for US boarding of sanctioned vessels
item.description: The Government has said that any future UK support for United States operations to board sanctioned vessels would be considered on a case-by-case basis, with decisions informed by legal advice and operational circumstances. The post UK weighs support for US boarding of sanctioned vessels first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Three of six Type 45 Destroyers operational
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that three of the Royal Navy’s Type 45 destroyers are currently operational, following a parliamentary question on the availability of the class. The post Three of six Type 45 Destroyers operational first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK Government criticises Scottish defence support policy
item.description: The UK Government has raised concerns about the potential impact of the Scottish Government’s defence sector support policy on jobs, skills and investment, following a parliamentary question, the UK Defence Journal understands. The post UK Government criticises Scottish defence support policy first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Germany orders more Meteor missiles
item.description: Germany has signed a contract for additional Meteor beyond-visual-range air-to-air missiles to support the Bundeswehr’s combat aircraft. The post Germany orders more Meteor missiles first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US and partners open new air defence cell in Qatar
item.description: U.S. Central Command and regional partners have established a new air and missile defence coordination cell at Al Udeid Air Base in Qatar, the command stated. The post US and partners open new air defence cell in Qatar first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Indonesia signs deal for two more UK-designed frigates
item.description: Indonesia has signed an agreement paving the way for the acquisition of two additional UK-designed Arrowhead 140 frigates, as part of a partnership with Babcock. The post Indonesia signs deal for two more UK-designed frigates first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy patrol ships rotate in Falklands mission
item.description: The Royal Navy has carried out a planned rotation of its South Atlantic patrol vessels, with HMS Medway taking over duties around the Falkland Islands as HMS Forth begins her return to the UK. The post Royal Navy patrol ships rotate in Falklands mission first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Stealth warship completes sea trials after hypersonic fit
item.description: U.S. Navy destroyer USS Zumwalt has successfully completed builder sea trials following a major modernisation programme that will see the ship become the first American naval platform for hypersonic weapons. The post Stealth warship completes sea trials after hypersonic fit first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK to spend nearly half a billion upgrading Typhoon fighters
item.description: More than half a billion pounds has been committed this week to upgrading the Royal Air Force’s Typhoon fighter fleet. The post UK to spend nearly half a billion upgrading Typhoon fighters first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
